summary: Click Holdings Ltd. (Nasdaq: CLIK), a Hong Kong HR and senior-care provider, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 carrying a press release highlighting selected findings from a Morningstar Quantitative Equity Research Report dated October 7, 2026. Morningstar's quantitative fair value estimate is US$2.02 per share against a US$1.09 close on October 6, 2026, implying a 46% discount, with market capitalization cited at US$9.33 million. The rating is capped at 3 stars given Very High uncertainty and value-trap caution. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; the filing is informational management commentary.
